description: Practical analyses and examples of ExteraGram 12.5.1+ / AyuGram plugins (Python, Chaquopy, Xposed-style hooks). Not a full API reference. Docs are in Russian.
rules: This repo is a collection of practical examples and analyses of real plugins. It is not a full API reference and not a limit on what plugins can do; for the API see the official docs at plugins.exteragram.app/docs, the Telegram for Android sources and decompiled ExteraGram.
Plugins target ExteraGram 12.5.1+ and AyuGram, are written in Python (Chaquopy) and use Xposed-style hooks. The analyses are written in Russian.
Treat the patterns in the analyses as proven examples with reasons behind them; adapt them or go beyond them when the task needs it.
Class and method names can change between app versions (R8), so verify them against the target version instead of assuming names from these examples.
